parts:
Dear Karl, 

I found this script you wrote about 4 years ago : 
https://github.com/pjotrp/rqtl/blob/master/R/stepwiseqtl.R

Do you have a tutorial for that?

Thanks so much, 

Jonathan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] script stepwiseqtl.R
parts:
It's part of the R/qtl package, so you'd want to run it from there; there's a help file.

library(qtl)
?stepwiseqtl

It's also covered in the following tutorial:

http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/new_multiqtl.pdf

Or see chapter 9 of the R/qtl book (http://www.rqtl.org/book)

karl
